jobs.title: Solutions Engineer Level 1 - London
jobs.description:

* Write technical documentation about special projects and the new processes

* Assist Solutions Engineers in production server maintenance and new version deployments for applications

* Detail oriented with strong problem\-solving skills
* Superior written and spoken communication skills in English

**DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Curiosity and drive to keep up with emerging AI tools and share best practices with the team
* Able to multitask in a fast\-paced environment

jobs.title: .NET Full Stack Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**.NET Full Stack Senior Software Engineer**


We are seeking talented professionals to join a high\-profile digital transformation programme for a leading global fashion retailer. This team plays a pivotal role in delivering the high\-quality imagery, video, and digital content that power customer experiences across multiple markets. Supported by significant investment in advanced technologies, AI\-enabled content solutions, and cloud\-native platforms, the programme is evolving from traditional production workflows to a scalable, data\-driven content ecosystem. This transformation enables faster speed to market, enhanced personalisation, and more immersive shopping experiences for millions of customers worldwide. The role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to innovative solutions at the intersection of creativity, technology, and operational excellence, while working within a collaborative, forward\-thinking delivery team focused on driving measurable business impact.

**What you’ll be doing**


As a **Senior Software Engineer**, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the technology behind a business\-critical content production and delivery platform for a leading global fashion retailer. Working with modern agentic AI and accelerated development practices, you'll help build and evolve applications using **.NET Core, React, Docker, and Kubernetes**, while championing engineering best practices such as **TDD** and **CI/CD automation**. Your work will directly support the creation, management, and delivery of high\-quality digital content at scale, enabling engaging customer experiences for millions of users worldwide.

* Work as part of an enthusiastic and motivated Agile development team that takes pride in delivering high\-quality software into production.
* Collaborate closely with business analysts, product stakeholders, and engineers to break down feature requirements into well\-defined backlog items for development.
* Continuously enhance and improve existing codebases, platforms, and technologies while contributing to the design and delivery of new features and capabilities.
* Contribute to the adoption of engineering best practices, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with modern software development standards.
* Mentor junior team members, share technical knowledge, and support the team in achieving sprint goals and delivery commitments.
* Work collaboratively across cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions that drive operational efficiency and business value.

 **Key Skills and Experience**

* A customer first mind set
* Expertise and experience in a broad base of technologies, ideally .NET Core (C\#) \& ASP.NET Core, CosmosDB, SQL, Azure ServiceBus, AKS, React/node.js
* Agentic \& vibe coding practices
* A good understanding of the Application Lifecycle and a solid understanding of Quality Assurance, Database Engineering and Build and deployment
* An appreciation for a properly layered architecture
* An ability to understand and model the business domain
* In\-depth knowledge of the tools and practices available and appropriate to each phase of software delivery, such as:
	+ DDD, TDD, BDD, Integration Testing, Performance Testing
	+ CQRS, Event Sourcing, Event Storming
	+ CI, Continuous Delivery, Build Automation
	+ JavaScript and associated UI frameworks and web technologies
	+ Relational and non\-relational database technologies (e.g. SQL Server and Cosmos)
	+ Cloud based development \& delivery platforms (ideally Microsoft Azure)
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* A constant drive for self\-improvement
* An ability to actively promote ideas and techniques within the team
* A desire to be at the forefront of technical discussion and design
* A product focus with a desire to build great experiences for our customers

**Additional eligibility requirements:**

* Candidates must currently reside in the UK.
* Candidates must be available to start within 4 weeks of receiving an offer.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Booking Engine
jobs.description:
#### **About Tripstack**


Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019\. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining.


Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform \- giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non\-partner, low\-cost and full\-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost\-effective API.
Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily.
Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection.  

For more information, visit:  

www.tripstack.com
www.etraveligroup.com#### **The Role**


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Booking Engine organization. You will own the technical direction of systems at the core of our product \- pricing, availability and booking flows that serve millions of requests per day. Beyond writing code, you will set architectural direction, unblock others, and represent the team's technical position to product and to peer engineering groups.


This role suits someone who is a natural problem solver, detail\-oriented, and comfortable moving between deep individual contribution and technical leadership in a fast\-paced environment.


This is a senior individual contributor role with technical leadership scope. We do not have a separate formal tech lead title.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Set and drive the technical direction for one or more Booking Engine services \- make architecture decisions, document the trade\-offs, and act as the technical point of contact in planning, prioritization and dependency discussions
* Design, write, review, test and support C\#/.NET code for reliable, high\-quality systems at scale serving millions of requests per day
* Break large initiatives into deliverable increments \- design solutions, get them reviewed, create stories, deliver and maintain
* Own latency, availability and cost characteristics of your services, and keep them within the reliability targets the organization sets
* Maintain and evolve our gRPC\-based API 2\.0 alongside the .NET services it fronts, keeping the two in step as the API surface changes
* Proactively identify technology opportunities for the company, and push technical ideas, proposals and plans to the entire organization
* Work cross\-functionally with product managers, client integration teams and other engineering groups to deliver high\-quality products and improve internal KPIs
* Coordinate and monitor regular releases to production
* Participate in the on\-call support rotation, lead the team through incidents impacting live systems, and drive follow\-up actions to completion
* Raise the engineering bar, mentor engineers through interactive code review, design review and knowledge\-sharing sessions, and help the team make good use of AI\-assisted development tooling

#### **Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or related technical field experience
* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience with C\# and .NET, including production work on .NET Core / .NET 8\+
* Strong command of the .NET runtime under load, including performance trade\-offs, caching, profiling and benchmarking
* Strong software design and architecture skills \- CS fundamentals, object\-oriented analysis and design patterns, and large\-scale distributed systems
* Hands\-on experience with Claude Code or equivalent AI coding assistants in production work, with sound judgement about when to rely on them and how to review what they produce
* Proven track record of designing and architecting scalable, high\-availability distributed systems serving internet traffic direct to consumers or businesses at scale
* Demonstrated technical leadership, having led the design and delivery of a significant system across multiple engineers and grown the engineers around you
* Experience owning production services on call, including leading incident response
* Ability to clearly and concisely communicate with technical and non\-technical stakeholders across all levels of the organization

#### **Additional Experience That Would Be Considered An Asset**

* Experience designing and publishing client SDKs or public\-facing APIs consumed by external partners
* Experience with hybrid Google Cloud Platform or other cloud providers and cloud\-native architecture alongside local data centre deployments
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD tooling
* Experience with monitoring dashboards (Grafana), alerting, logging, and PCI\-related work
* Experience with gRPC and protobuf\-based service contracts
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous architectures, including message brokers and delivery guarantees
* Experience in the flight booking domain

#### **Benefits**


We offer an opportunity to work with a young, dynamic, and a growing team composed of high\-caliber professionals. We value professionalism and promote a culture where individuals are encouraged to do more and be more. If you feel you share our passion for excellence, and growth, then look no further. We have an ambitious mission, and we need a world\-class team to make it a reality. Upgrade to a First Class team!


At Tripstack, we proudly believe in embracing diversity. This is true for our team, clients, communities and stakeholders. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating a safe, healthy and accessible environment. We encourage applications regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other grounds protected by law. Please let us know if you need any accommodations during any part of the recruitment process.


Tripstack thanks all applicants for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.  

  

Learn more about us at www.tripstack.com

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – C#.net and APL
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer – C\#.net and APL**

  

**WHO WE ARE**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become a top provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.


SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.  



  

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide high\-quality solutions to our clients  



  

**WHAT MAKES US, US**

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!  



  

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.  



  

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!  



  

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Transactions \& Private Debt product area and contribute to business\-critical functionality used by our clients in their daily investment operations.  



  

You will work as part of an experienced engineering team, contributing to backend development, component design, performance, reliability and maintainability. The work is technically interesting because it combines complex business logic, long\-lived enterprise software and the need to keep improving how we build and deliver functionality.  



  

Most of the current product logic is written in APL, while we are increasing our use of C\#/.NET and AI in new development, integrations, cloud enablement, and platform modernization. You do not need prior APL experience. We will provide training and support and we are looking for someone who is curious enough to learn what is needed while bringing solid engineering practices from C\#/.NET.  



  

You will work with experienced engineers across locations and have room to contribute to how we build, modernize and evolve the product.  



  

**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help the team build reliable, maintainable and well\-tested backend solutions. In practice, you will:


Design, implement, test and maintain backend functionality using APL and, where relevant, C\#/.NET


Contribute to component design, code quality, performance and long\-term maintainability


Work closely with product managers, engineers and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver client\-relevant functionality


Improve reliability and delivery through code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD and pragmatic engineering practices


Investigate technical issues, performance bottlenecks and bugs and help design sustainable solutions


Share knowledge with colleagues and contribute to technical discussions within the team


Use Git\-based workflows and work effectively in a continuous integration environment.  



  

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, mathematics, or a related field.
* Solid engineering fundamentals: object\-oriented design, architecture patterns, clean code, and pragmatic problem solving
* Solid experience in C\#/.NET (Core/Framework) and building backend systems (APIs, services, integrations).
* Familiarity with APIs (REST/streaming patterns) and messaging concepts (e.g., service bus patterns).
* Experience with Azure or cloud\-based development is an advantage, but not a prerequisite
* Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, and Git\-based workflows.
* Good problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Ability to work with complex business logic and collaborate with both technical and non\-technical colleagues .

**APL READINESS**

You don’t need prior APL experience. What matters is curiosity and willingness to learn. We provide training and a supportive environment to help you succeed, and SimCorp partly owns Dyalog APL, helping ensure the language remains actively maintained and relevant.  

* 

  

**NICE\-TO\-HAVE**

* FinTech / regulated\-industry experience.
* Exposure to vector\-based or functional languages (helpful for ramping up in APL).
* Experience with Azure services or cloud\-based development.
Experience mentoring other engineers or taking ownership of a component.  
* 

  

  

**BENEFITS**

* Flexible working hours and hybrid model \- 2 days in the office, 3 days remote
* Modern office (next to Wilanowska metro station) with quiet zones and ergonomic workstations
* Base salary with annual bonus structure
* Holiday allowance upon a 2\-week vacation
* Occasional remote work across Poland and international options available (up to 24 days domestic, 20 days international per year \- subject to internal policy)
* Employer\-paid Medicover Platinum healthcare package (employee\-paid family upgrade available)
* Multisport card with 75% employer contribution
* Unum group life insurance (employee\-paid upgrade available)
* Medicover travel insurance for private trips and global business travel insurance
* Possibility to join Deutsche Börse Group Share Plan (eligible after 1 year)
* Copyrights program for certain roles
* Possibility to develop your career in an international environment
* Professional training and courses provided by SimCorp
* Polish language classes for foreign employees; German and English classes based on business needs
Integration events, volunteering initiatives and employee\-led clubs  
* 

  

**NEXT STEPS**

Please click below to apply or get in touch with Tangella Viswanath, Recruitment Consultant or you may send an email to viswanath.tangella@simcorp.com to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp has to offer regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process, we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

jobs.description:
**Graduate, Automation Engineer Cork**

  

At Dell Technologies, innovation is powered by advanced manufacturing technologies and automation solutions that enable world\-class quality, efficiency, and scalability. The Automation Engineering team plays a critical role in designing, implementing, and supporting automated manufacturing systems that bring our products to life.


Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Graduate Automation Engineer on our Cork Manufacturing Engineering team in Cork.

 **What you'll achieve**


As a Graduate Automation Engineer, you will work with local and global cross\-functional teams to develop, support, and optimize manufacturing automation solutions within Cork Manufacturing Operations. You will gain hands\-on experience with industrial automation systems, robotics, controls, and digital manufacturing technologies while supporting both New Product Introduction (NPI) and steady\-state manufacturing operations.

**You will:**

* Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of automated manufacturing systems and processes.
* Assist in the programming, troubleshooting, and optimization of PLC\-controlled equipment.
* Support the integration and commissioning of robotics and automated manufacturing equipment.
* Develop and maintain software tools, scripts, and applications to improve manufacturing efficiency and data visibility.
* Assist with troubleshooting automation, controls, and communication issues across manufacturing systems.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to support New Product Introduction activities and manufacturing readiness.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on productivity, quality, automation, and operational excellence.

 **Essential Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree (Level 8\) in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Understanding of PLC programming, including Siemens and/or Allen\-Bradley platforms.
* Familiarity with robotics and automated manufacturing equipment.
* Programming experience in Python, C\#, Java, SQL, or similar programming languages.
* Understanding of industrial communication protocols, including:
	+ Ethernet/IP
	+ Modbus
	+ Profinet
	+ OPC\-UA
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good troubleshooting capability and attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively within cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated willingness and enthusiasm to learn new technologies and automation platforms.
* Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Desirable Requirements:**

* Knowledge of SCADA and HMI systems.
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.

**Here’s our story; now tell us yours**


Dell Technologies helps organizations and individuals build a brighter digital tomorrow. Our company is made up of more than 150,000 people, located in over 180 locations around the world. jobs.title: Project Engineer - Dispatchable Generation Teams, Asset Development
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 28643
Category: Engineering \- Project Management
Job Type: Full\-time  

**Position Description**

  

Asset Development is tasked with identifying, developing and constructing new investment opportunities on behalf of ESB Group. Asset Development activities comprise identifying and developing opportunities to enhance our portfolio to realise our Brighter Future strategy. The opportunities are managed through development and construction to commercial operation. The Flexible Technology Development unit within Asset Development has successfully developed flexible generation, battery and synchronous compensator projects in the last two years.


EirGrid and ESB Networks are developing market competitions for building long duration energy storage (LDES) projects. Flexible Technology Development is responsible for developing a pipeline of generation and LDES projects and system support technologies (eg synchronous compensation), along with opportunities for flexible generation assets to meet market requirements.


The successful candidates will support the Project Director on assigned project development activities such as establishing techno\-commercial feasibility of projects, landowner engagement, overseeing planning activities and project design. The role will involve working closely with team members across the various business units in ESB including engineering, planning and legal specialists.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Support project teams in assessing and developing opportunities, including greenfield and brownfield sites, new technologies and acquisitions.
* Engage internal and external stakeholders to secure permits, authorisations, planning and connection agreements.
* Deliver assigned work to ESB project management standards, meeting technical, commercial, legal, procurement and programme requirements.
* Support preparation of projects for market competitions, including storage, capacity and system services.
* Research technology areas with commercial potential.
* Manage procurement and contract strategy, and coordinate project contracts.
* Support delivery of Safe and Sound across all projects.
* Promote a strong team culture and open communication across the project team and Asset Development.
* Research project or industry issues affecting delivery and present conclusions.
  

**Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

  

* Ability to assess opportunities across technical, environmental, regulatory, market and financial factors.
* Experience working independently, owning projects.
* Ability to plan and communicate requirements to progress projects and new initiatives.
* Third\-level qualification in engineering, commercial, planning or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years’ postgraduate experience.
* Proven experience delivering projects.
  

**Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Knowledge of planning and permitting for large energy projects.
* Experience negotiating with landowners and managing local stakeholder relationships.
* Knowledge of energy generation technologies and their assessment.
* Knowledge of energy markets and regulatory supports in Ireland and the UK.
* Knowledge of procurement procedures.
* Understanding of the power generation business.
  

**Essential Qualifications**

  

* 3rd level primary degree in engineering, commercial, planning or equivalent work experience.
  

**Desirable Qualifications**


* Project management or other business qualifications that complement the knowledge, skills and experience listed above.
  

**Location**

  

This position will be based in ESB’s Head Office, 27 Fitzwilliam Street Lower, Dublin, D02 KT92\.


Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in\-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in\-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business.

  

**Reporting to**

  

Manager Flexible Technologies, Asset Development.

  

**Why Work with Us?**

  

* Work on nationally important dispatchable generation projects that support security of supply, renewable integration and the transition of gas turbine assets toward lower\-carbon and net\-zero fuels.
* Develop your career through mentoring, training and exposure to strategic energy projects.
* Be part of a values\-led, inclusive team culture with opportunities to contribute to Corporate Social Responsibility initiatives.
* Connect with colleagues through sports and social clubs, networking opportunities and a great team environment.
* Access Credit Union membership, a generous pension and staff well\-being programmes.
* Benefit from generous parental leave entitlements and supports that recognise life outside work.
* Join an organisation with a strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.
  

**Salary**  

€59,980 \- €70,564 per annum  

**Closing Date**


15th October 2026

  

**Interview**

  

Candidates who are shortlisted for interview will complete a Behavioural Interview based on each of the following Behaviours, which underpin how we work at ESB and are critical to delivering our strategy:

  

* Accountable and Ethical
* Collaborative
* Growing and Adaptive
* Proactive
* Respectful and Supportive

jobs.title: Manager (Engineering), Digital Innovation Studio
jobs.description:
Family Group: Administration
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

**Job Title:**


Manager (Engineering), Digital Innovation Studio

  

**NHG Vision: Adding years of healthy life**  

**CHI Mission: Driving innovation for systems change**  

The Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) is committed to catalysing and driving innovation for systems change in healthcare, thereby adding years of healthy life. Built on the foundation of co\-learning and collaboration, CHI’s core is in facilitating innovation through its suite of platforms and programmes. CHI has built a dynamic network of local and international partners who are dedicated to fostering innovation, creating thought leadership, co\-building initiatives to inculcate and embed a culture of innovation within healthcare. We spearhead innovation by driving the adoption of the CHI Innovation Cycle, care and process redesign and in the use of technology. CHI leads transformation at the care, systems and ecosystem levels to achieve better health and healthcare.  

**About the Digital Innovation Office (DIO)**  

  

The Digital Innovation Office (DIO) under the Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) drives NHG Health’s digital transformation across three key platforms: Digital Hospital, Digital Community, and Health Empowered by AI Launchpad (HEAL).  

DIO’s mission is to enable transformation and deliver impact by supporting institution\-led platforms that advance workforce and care transformation. Through collaborative programmes and partnerships, DIO serves as a catalyst for AI adoption at scale and digital innovation across hospitals and community care.  

**JOB SUMMARY**  

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Digital Innovation Studio (DIS), the role will manage DIS’s proof\-of\-concept (POC) platforms consisting of multi\-cloud sandbox environments and maintain full technical understanding of their AI and/or IT standards. The candidate will undertake important technical activities together with NHG project teams for the robust prototyping of digital solutions that support CHI’s digital and AI\-enabled future.  

In addition, the candidate will participate in user\-engaged product iteration, and technology ecosystem stewardship—working closely with clinicians, operations teams, UX specialists, data scientists, and industry partners.  

**MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**  

1\. **Technical Prototype Engineering**


* Design and support the development of lightweight prototypes, including front\-end interfaces, back\-end services, and workflow components.
* Collaborate with project teams to define technical requirements and translate business needs into implementable solution designs, ensuring alignment with security and scalability considerations.
* Develop technical documentation such as PRDs that include human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) workflow and guardrail/safety mechanisms, and architecture diagrams.
* Provide hands\-on support for prototype development, testing, and technical troubleshooting.

**2\. Sandbox Platform Management**
-----------------------------------

* Maintain DIS multi\-cloud sandbox environments across AWS, Azure and/or GCP, including user onboarding, resource provisioning, and access management .
* Manage and optimise additional enterprise prototyping platforms, ensuring users can effectively build solutions using pre\-established services and reusable architecture patterns.
* Engage industry cloud providers and healthcare IT vendors to stay abreast of emerging platforms, integration approaches, and capabilities, and advise project teams on designing prototypes aligned with target deployment environments.
  

**3\. Administrative support**
* Support DIS in secretariat or administrative work where needed.
* Design and deliver hands\-on training workshops on modern software development practices and the effective use of cloud\-based tools and platforms.
  

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**  

(A) EDUCATION, TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
* 5 years hands\-on engineering experience (front\-end or back\-end in cloud environment).
* Ability to build and iterate prototypes using both traditional development stacks (e.g. JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, .NET) and low\-code/no\-code tools within enterprise security constraints.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS preferred), containerized deployments, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Proficient in drafting PRDs and creating pragmatic lightweight solution architectures to guide technical implementation
  

**Desired Skills*** Passion for healthcare and to create new solutions that can benefit patients or hospital systems.
* Experience working in healthcare, or with standards such as HL7/FHIR, is advantageous.
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles, data protection, and safe experimentation in enterprise settings.
* Experience working with vendors or external tech partners is a bonus.
* Flexible mindset to adopt new platforms and create new technical frameworks or processes in our evolving environment

jobs.description:
Job Purpose and Core Tasks
  
  

The Software Cloud Manager is a senior leadership\-role within the cloud development organization, combining deep hands\-on technical expertise with end\-to\-end ownership of global cloud delivery. This role is responsible for designing, building, and operating scalable, secure cloud solutions that underpin medical and non\-medical digital products across mobile and web platforms, used by customers globally. With significant experience in cloud software engineering, the Software Cloud Manager leads a distributed team across Israel and Singapore, directly managing engineers and driving cross\-functional initiatives that span product, architecture, operations, and quality. The role is accountable for setting technical direction, achieving delivery and reliability KPIs, and ensuring that cloud platforms can scale with business growth.
  
  

**Global team leadership:**  

Lead and develop a global engineering team located in Singapore and Israel, providing clear technical direction, coaching and performance management.
  
  

Build team capability through mentoring, structured feedback and talent development, ensuring succession and technical depth in critical cloud areas.
  
  

Architecture and technical ownership
  
  

Own architecture and design decisions for cloud capabilities across mobile and web, including APIs, dataflows, security, observability and deployment pipelines.
  
  

Ensure operational excellence across cloud environments, including monitoring, alerting, reliability, capacity management and incident response.
  
  

Evaluate and adopt cloud services (GCP, AWS or Azure) to balance cost, performance and reliability, and ensure designs meet regulatory and security requirements.
  
  

Execution and delivery accountability
  
  

Lead cloud development planning, prioritization and execution, translating product and business priorities into a clear backlog and delivery roadmap.
  
  

Take ownership for high quality, on time delivery of features and foundational cloud capabilities, using modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews).
  
  

Operational excellence and reliability
  
  

Ensure operational excellence across cloud environments, including monitoring, alerting, reliability, capacity management and incident response.
  
  

Define and track SLOs/SLAs for key services, lead post incident reviews, and drive continuous improvement to reduce downtime and improve user experience.
  
  

Cross functional leadership
  
  

Partner with Product Management, DataOps, QA, Security and other stakeholders to align cloud development with product roadmap and business outcomes.
  
  

Represent the cloud team in cross functional forums, communicate trade\-offs and risks clearly, and ensure stakeholders have transparency on progress and constraints.
  
  

Technical contributor
  
  

Contribute directly to complex technical tasks where needed (e.g. critical design, performance investigations, major refactors), while maintaining a strong focus on enabling the team.
  
  

Read and interpret complex technical documentation, troubleshoot end to end issues across stack layers, and provide practical solutions.
  
  

All other responsibilities as directed
  
  

I. Minimum Knowledge, Education and Skill Requirements
  
  

Required
  
  

**Minimum years of relevant work experience:**  

7\+ years of experience in software engineering with a focus on cloud\-based architectures and distributed systems.
  
  

Proven experience with major cloud providers (GCP, AWS or Azure), including design and operation of production workloads.
  
  

Ability to define and drive engineering excellence standards (code quality, testing, documentation, observability).
  
  

Experience withGit\-based source control and collaborative development workflows (branching, pull requests, code reviews).
  
  

Track record of successfully delivering cross‑functional global cloud projects from design through rollout and operations, with measurable impact on product or customer outcomes.
  
  

**Minimum education, certifications and/or credentials:**  

BSc/MSc in Computer Science or related engineering degree.
  
  

Strong proficiency in Python and C\# (or similar languages such as Java) for backend services and automation.
  
  

Solid understanding of web technologies, including RESTful APIs, HTML, JavaScript, and modern frameworks.
  
  

**Minimum soft skill requirements:**  

Demonstrated experience leading engineers directly, including responsibility for performance management, coaching and team development.
  
  

Ability to work independently, take ownership of complex topics and move them forward with minimal supervision.
  
  

High level of problem\-solving ability, with a practical, solution\-oriented mindset and resilience under pressure.
  
  

Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to work effectively across time zones and cultures.
  
  

KARL STORZ VentureONE Pte. Ltd. is a fully owned subsidiary of KARL STORZ SE \& Co. KG headquartered in Singapore with a business focus on robotic solutions, artificial intelligence, and virtual reality.

jobs.title: Process Validation Engineer Cell Therapy
jobs.description:
**What is offered?**
--------------------



At MindCapture you are not just starting a new role. You are joining a community that invests in your development and gives you the opportunity to grow in a meaningful technical career within healthcare.



You can count on:


* A competitive salary with a full benefits package including meal vouchers, eco vouchers, health insurance, group insurance, net expense allowance and a company car with charging or fuel card
* Personal growth support with tailored training and clear career development
* A stable environment where your technical skills directly contribute to improved patient care
* The chance to work with high tech diagnostic systems at top tier healthcare institutions
* A warm and collaborative culture focused on trust, ownership and long term impact


**Job description**
-------------------


As Process Validation Engineer, you will coordinate validation activities within a new manufacturing environment. Your scope includes process validation, sterilisation validation, technology transfer, equipment introduction and technical documentation while ensuring compliance with current regulatory and GMP requirements.


**Key responsibilities**


* Validation strategy: Define, plan and coordinate PPQ, smoke studies, hold time validation, APQ and APS activities.
* Validation guidance: Provide technical guidance on validation and qualification activities.
* Revalidation: Ensure timely revalidation of manufacturing and sterilisation processes.
* Documentation: Write, review and approve validation plans, protocols and reports.
* Technology transfer: Participate in product transfer and manufacturing system introduction activities.
* Process improvement: Contribute to optimisation projects for manufacturing systems and processes.
* Compliance review: Review technical documentation against regulatory requirements and current industry practices.
* Project reporting: Provide accurate and timely progress updates to stakeholders and leadership.
**Required competences \& skills**
----------------------------------


* Education: Bachelor degree or higher in engineering, biotechnology, biomedical sciences or pharmacy.
* Industry experience: Experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, cell therapy or a related regulated industry.
* Manufacturing knowledge: Experience introducing pharmaceutical products into manufacturing environments.
* Technical expertise: Working knowledge of manufacturing operations and late stage development activities.
* GMP knowledge: Strong working knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices.
* Aseptic experience: Experience within controlled cleanroom environments under aseptic conditions is a plus.
* Project management: Ability to manage activities, priorities and reporting in a structured way.
* Problem solving: Strong decision making and problem solving skills under changing priorities.
* Collaboration: Ability to work independently while interacting effectively across organisational levels.
* Languages: Fluent written and spoken Dutch and English.

**At MindCapture as consultant**
**About this application**
--------------------------


This opportunity is offered through MindCapture as a consultancy role with strong day to day ownership. You will be placed on site with our client.


MindCapture supports you throughout your assignment with clear onboarding, regular follow up and access to learning opportunities. You will have a dedicated point of contact, transparent communication and support to help you deliver impact in a structured way.


**Job Contact –** **Talent \& Business Team**
---------------------------------------------


Our Talent \& Business Managers combine a deep understanding of our clients’ needs with a sharp eye for talent. Their focus is on creating meaningful and sustainable matches, always keeping both the role and the candidate in mind.


When a potential match is identified, one of our T\&B colleagues may reach out to answer your questions, share additional context about the role and discuss possible next steps together, with clarity and transparency throughout the process.


**How our application process works**
-------------------------------------


* **Apply online** – Submit your application in just a few clicks.

* **Personal interview** – If we see a potential match, our team reaches out to get to know you better, explore your skills and ambitions and hear what you value in your next challenge.

* **Client introduction** – We match you with potential projects and introduce you to clients where your expertise fits best.

* **Client interview \& feedback** – You meet with the client to explore project details and expectations, while we support you throughout the discussions and provide follow\-up afterwards.

* **Final interview \& welcome** – In a final chat with our team, we close the process and warmly welcome you to MindCapture, guiding you towards a smooth start with us or at the client site.
